game.title: Batman: Arkham Origins
game.blurb: Action-adventure set over one night in Gotham early in Batman's career, from Warner Bros. Interactive and Splash Damage (as RAWG lists the developers), released 2013-10-25. RAWG average playtime: 12 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: A young Batman faces a city full of assassins. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Gotham, Most Wanted and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Tower networks, Most Wanted missions, Black Mask's assassins, Enigma items, Anarky tags, Casefiles, crimes in progress and fast travel.

chapters.title: Combat, Predator and Gadgets
chapters.summary: Combos, silent takedowns, predator encounters, gliding, upgrades and boss fights without a slip.

chapters.title: Dark Knight System and Challenge Maps
chapters.summary: The Dark Knight tracks and medals on Combat Training, Custom, Ranked and Campaign challenge maps.

chapters.title: New Game Plus and I Am The Night
chapters.summary: Replaying in New Game Plus and finishing I Am The Night Mode.

chapters.title: Multiplayer
chapters.summary: Faction levels, prestige and match feats in multiplayer.

chapters.title: Cold, Cold Heart (DLC, likely)
chapters.summary: A block of achievements about the XE Suit, the cryodrill, Freeze, Boyle and frozen civilians.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 209000)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Batman:_Arkham_Origins
Fandom (batman.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://batman.fandom.com/wiki/Batman:_Arkham_Origins
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 1; its Table of Contents lists a Walkthrough and 11 named story and side-case pages, but the Walkthrough and those chapter pages are not written. Written subpages are only Achievements and trophies, Anarky, Controls, Dark Knight System, Table of Contents, The Penguin and Upgrades, so it was not used. batman.fandom.com answers the API, with about 117 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG lists the developers as Warner Bros. Interactive and Splash Damage, while StrategyWiki's page links WB Games Montreal; the blurb follows RAWG. The Steam schema gives only the placeholder name "ValveTestApp209000". 6 of 60 Steam achievements are hidden, all at the top of the list, and sit in the main story chapter. The Cold, Cold Heart chapter is inferred: only "Paint the Town Red" names it; the other nine were placed by schema position (achievements 51 to 60), including "Master Wayne" and "Down with the Revolution", which may need checking.
